svg.title: Boundary port outline primitive
svg.desc: Rounded outline primitive without a direction indicator; compose it as geometry rather than a complete boundary-port alternative. Outline only. The displayed boundary grammar includes pdh/pdv arrows and position-specific labels; the host supplies direction, placement and context. Nested/reference/proxy forms are not implemented.
